boundary: Exact restriction/character and module-packing statement for the finite H145 carrier. It does not supply masses, Yukawas, scalar sectors, phenomenology, or prove that order72 is globally maximal over every possible charge partition.

group.proof_contract: center has unique C3; derived subgroup is Q8; adjoining a noncentral order-3 element gives an order-24 complement K with Q8 normal and K/Q8=C3; central C3 intersects K trivially and C3*K has order72

identical_generation_factor_no_go.desired_form: charged module = C^15_SM tensor G5 with the same five-dimensional H-module G5 for every SM internal state
identical_generation_factor_no_go.reason: any irrep occurring once in G5 would need multiplicity at least15 in H145; only chi_00 has multiplicity >=15, so dim G5 <=1
